EVERYONE'S SAFETY

Providing Safe Supports

As part of our outbreak Prevention Program Shareth Homecare ensures to have a comprehensive infection prevention and control COVID-19 response in place.

  • All support workers are fully vaccinated in line with public health guidelines
  • Have an infection control lead at our facility
  • Trained staff who can demonstrate full competency in infection prevention and control
  • Maintain ongoing supply of Personal Protective Equipment (PPE) and to use them as required.
